# Rotozest Industries

> Manufacturer and supplier of Stainless Steel (SS) and Cast Iron (CI) rotary gear pumps, based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, with supply across India. Pumps for oil, chemicals, food, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, paints, agriculture, lubrication and other viscous liquids. CE and ISO certified.

## Products
- [SS Rotary Gear Pump](https://www.rotozest.com/ss-rotary-gear-pump/): corrosion-resistant, hygienic stainless steel gear pumps for chemicals, pharma, food and cosmetics.
- [CI Rotary Gear Pump](https://www.rotozest.com/ci-rotary-gear-pump/): durable cast iron gear pumps for oils, lubricants, syrups and viscous fluids.
- [Applications](https://www.rotozest.com/applications/): the 12 industries the pumps serve.
